rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow standing decision holding that a self-initiated review of a public hotel website, without intent to book, is an insufficiently concrete injury under Spokeo/TransUnion and is meaningfully different from Havens. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Thomas or Gorsuch (originalist/separation-of-powers gloss) and from the dissenters (to defend Havens-style tester/informational-injury standing and warn about underenforcement of online ADA barriers).
